label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, no request reaches Discord and the wallet is never read.

label: Bot token secret
help: Wallet reference holding the bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Needed to send, read, react, upload and watch. Never the token itself.

label: Webhook URL secret
help: Optional wallet reference holding a channel webhook URL, for webhook_send notifications without a bot.

label: Allowed channel IDs
help: JSON array of channel IDs the bot may use, for example ["1234567890123456789"]. Required with a bot token. Copy an ID with Developer Mode on.

label: Default channel ID
help: Used when a request gives no channel_id; it must be in the allowed list.

label: Plain text sends with
help: Operation used for plain text and for JSON without operation: the bot (send_message) or the webhook (webhook_send).

label: Mentions
help: Who may be pinged. none: nobody; users: mentioned users; users_roles: users and roles; all: also @everyone and @here.

label: Allow writes
help: Off by default. Required to send, edit, react, upload and use the webhook.

label: Allow delete
help: Separate switch for delete_message. Discord has no recycle bin: a deleted message cannot be restored.

label: Upload folder
help: Only files inside this folder can be uploaded from the file input.

label: Upload size limit (bytes)
help: Larger files are refused before anything is sent. Discord allows 10 MiB on servers without boosts.

label: Messages per read (max)
help: Upper bound for one read_messages; a request limit can only lower it.

label: Watch channels
help: In Active Runtime, poll the channels for new messages and emit them on messages. One Shot polls once per watch request.

label: Watched channel IDs
help: JSON array, a subset of the allowed channels. Empty watches every allowed channel (at most 20).

label: Poll interval (s)
help: At least 10 seconds between two polls of the Run listener.

label: Emit recent messages on first start
help: Off: the first start only records the newest message. On: messages of the window below are emitted once, in bounded polls.

label: Recent window (hours)
help: How far back the first start looks when Emit recent messages is on.

label: Messages per poll (max)
help: More messages wait for the next poll; none is skipped.

label: Include bot and webhook messages
help: Off by default, so the block never reacts to its own messages.

label: Messages per page
help: limit sent with each read of channel messages, at most 100 (Discord's maximum).

label: Pages per read (max)
help: Pages per read, and per channel in a watch poll.

label: Operation deadline (s)
help: Total time for one request or poll, pages, rate-limit waits and retries included.

label: Retries
help: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; writes only after HTTP 429.

label: Longest rate-limit wait (s)
help: A retry_after or bucket reset above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting.

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger Discord responses are refused as protocol errors.

label: Discord API origin
help: Keep https://discord.com. Another origin receives the token; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
